guidance.heading: Updated Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: For the full year 2026, the Company now expects total revenue of between $660 million and
$670 million, and non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA of between $137 million and $142 million. The
Company will provide additional details on its third quarter 2026 earnings call.
Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA is provided in the full year 2026 Outlook on a forward-looking
most directly comparable financial measures calculated and presented in accordance with
difficulty of projecting event driven transactional and other non-core operating items in any
future period. The magnitude of these items, however, may be significant.

desk.headline: Record revenue up 49% to $182.1m, beat; full-year revenue and EBITDA outlook cut
results: Revenue rose 49% to a record $182.1m; without this year's acquisitions, growth was about 20%.
All three markets grew by double digits, led by sensing and precision strike, which nearly quadrupled to $48.7m on missile-defence demand.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 37% to $39.7m, but the margin slipped to 21.8% from 23.6%.
Net income of $30.6m ($0.18 a share) was lifted by a $24.2m tax benefit.
Backlog reached $1.26bn; free cash flow was negative $9.5m as capital spending stepped up.

guidance.summary: Applied cut its 2026 targets: revenue to $660–670m from $670–690m and adjusted EBITDA to $137–142m from $150–155m.

points: Q3 orders of about $254m were 1.4 times revenue; about 75% of expected 2027 revenue is already covered by firm orders.
About $15–20m of helicopter aftermarket work, including Apache rotor overhauls, moves from Q4 into the first half of 2027.
Start-up costs, equipment delays and supplier shortages hurt margins; Q4 gross margin is expected near 26%, about 2 points below plan.
Margins are seen staying near that level in early 2027 before recovering to the high 20s in the second half.
Management expects positive free cash flow in Q4 and more acquisitions; debt fell to about $410m after the IPO.
call.source: Q3 2026 call transcript — Earnings Whispers, 11 Nov 2026; prior outlook from the Q2 2026 release (12 Aug 2026)

watch: Whether gross margin recovers from start-up and supply problems as new programmes ramp.
Timing of the delayed Apache overhaul work and the government approvals it needs.
Conversion of the $1.26bn backlog and free cash flow turning positive.
